newsitem.title: USA: Healthsouth buys ReadiCare, in $70 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Healthsouth buys ReadiCare, in $70 mln deal.

text.p: Healthsouth Corp said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy ReadiCare Inc. The transaction is valued at about $70 million and would close in the fourth quarter, the company said.

Both companies' boards have approved the deal, Healthsouth said. The company said ReadiCare stockholders would get 0.2425 shares of Healthsouth common stock per ReadCare share under the agreement, and that the exchange ratio would be adjusted if Healthsouth's average stock price rises above $38.30 per share or falls below $30.60 during the measuring period.
